Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
If Diversion is the combat card put on a Shadow Court Satyr, can the
Satyr use it in combat? (Diversion requires an Anarch)

Messages.Author: Ego_Sum
Messages.Body:
emmits...@hotmail.com (Emmit Svenson) wrote in message news:<75bdf7ed.03051...@posting.google.com>...

> If Diversion is the combat card put on a Shadow Court Satyr, can the
> Satyr use it in combat? (Diversion requires an Anarch)

It can use it but only once each combat (see Satyr text) so each
combat you have to decide wheter to drink, double strike or prevent.
Otherwise is a huge card for the little guy...

Greetings,

Iñaki, Prince of Barcelona.-

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
On 18 May 2003 15:14:33 -0700, inaki.pu...@estudiant.upc.es
(Ego_Sum) scrawled:



it can't use reality mirror, because that requires a malk.

why would it be able to use a card that requires an anarch?

Changeling with 3 life. 1 strength, 1 bleed. When Shadow Court Satyr
comes into play, you may put a combat card from your hand on him. Once
each combat, Satyr may use the ability of that card as if that card
had been played from your hand. If the card has a cost, he pays its
cost in life to use its ability. If the card requires a Discipline, he
may only use the basic ability of that card as a vampire with a
capacity of 1. If the ability would give him blood, give him life
instead.

it says nothing about requirements other than discipline.
